title: The Shadow That Went Backward
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The king was sick and very sad,
He turned and faced the wall,
He prayed, “Remember how I’ve tried
To follow You through all.”

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father hears my prayer
Whenever I feel sad,
He listens close and answers me,
And makes my heart feel glad.

[Verse 2]
God heard him right away and said,
“I’ll make you well and fine,”
He gave him fifteen more good years,
The shadow moved, a sign!

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
So when you’re sick or sad tonight,
Just whisper up a prayer,
Then close your eyes, for He can hear,
For God is always there.

[Chorus]
mood: Hushed music. A very soft, slow rocking pulse moves under the voice like a hand on a feverish forehead, tender and close, matching a sick king turning his face to the wall to pray. The chorus lifts gently, the way a heart lifts when an answer comes, and the second verse has a small hush of wonder as the shadow slips backward. By the last verse the rocking slows almost to stillness, low and warm, and the song fades like a lamp turned down.
